summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no code changes made — this is a plan only)  **What I found (read-only audit, confirmed myself against the source):**  The watchlist code itself is clean. `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — every read/write goes through the API with the session cookie. `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` correctly resolves `X-User-Id` from a verified session and scopes every query (`GET /`, item add/remove) with `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. There's no default/guest watchlist logic. So this is **not** the wiring bug the ticket description gues
